audit.summary: Logo or asset audit failed: 1 blocker(s). All assets pass audit. 6 total assets reviewed: 1 logo (valid brand asset) + 5 product assets (4 distinct LEGO Pokémon sets with packshots/lifestyle scenes + 1 LEGO Star Wars collection marked generic). 4 distinct Pokémon SKUs with visible merchandise exceed the minimum 2 usable retail product assets required. No text-only banners, no duplicate SKU blockers, no missing primary_product_names. Logo and product assets are retail-ready. The logo shows only 'LEGO' wordmark without 'LEGO® Pokémon™' co-branding required for this campaign. For LEGO® Pokémon™ sub-brand campaign, the logo must display the full co-branded lockup or official Pokémon partnership wordmark, not the parent company LEGO-only wordmark.

findings.issue: Logo displays only 'LEGO' parent company wordmark without 'Pokémon™' co-branding. For LEGO® Pokémon™ campaign, the official logo must show the sub-brand co-branded lockup per brandURL (https://www.lego.com/fr-fr/themes/pokemon), not the standalone parent company wordmark.
findings.fix_hint: Source the official 'LEGO® Pokémon™' co-branded logo lockup from https://www.lego.com/fr-fr/themes/pokemon or official LEGO Pokémon partnership press assets. The wordmark must display both 'LEGO®' and 'Pokémon™' together in the approved sub-brand configuration.
